email_body:
Dear LIZY team,

I'm applying for the No-Code Automation Engineer for Business Ops role. Your focus on no-code workflows and internal tools to save hundreds of hours aligns with how I work: I use AI tools and code daily to automate repetitive tasks, from prompt engineering to Python scripts and MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools.

At Episto, I manage CMS content and SEO for client sites, and I've built and optimized multiple WordPress sites, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles. My technical background (Applied Computer Science coursework, front-end development) helps me understand how systems connect, which is key for robust automation.

I'm eager to bring my automation mindset to LIZY and collaborate with Product and Ops to scale efficient processes. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and open to the Brussels hybrid setup.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear LIZY team,

I'm writing to apply for the No-Code Automation Engineer for Business Ops role. Your mission to deploy robust internal tools and save hundreds of hours through automation resonates with my approach: I constantly look for ways to automate repetitive work using AI and code, and I enjoy building systems that make teams more efficient.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I use LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content, and audits, and I've integrated MCP into WordPress and SEO tools to streamline workflows. I also use Python automation and have built an Android app live on Google Play, which taught me how to connect different systems and think in terms of scalable processes. My technical background—including front-end development and Applied Computer Science coursework—gives me a solid understanding of how business, operations, and technology intersect.

At Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites and have built and optimized multiple WordPress sites, including a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages. This required consistent layout and efficient content management, skills that translate well to deploying internal tools. I've also worked on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large retail and logistics clients, where I saw firsthand how automation can save time across departments.

I'm excited about the opportunity to experiment with new AI trends and help scale automation at LIZY. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and comfortable with the hybrid Brussels/remote setup. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my automation mindset and technical skills can contribute to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
